findings.title: Forbidden connectivity permitted: reporting -> finance-db (ports [5432])
evidence: Egress from clavure-analytics/reporting: isolated by [clavure-analytics/allow-dns-egress, clavure-analytics/default-deny-all, clavure-analytics/reporting-egress-data]; permitted by clavure-analytics/reporting-egress-data egress[0] peers[0] on TCP/5432.

Ingress to clavure-data/finance-db: isolated by [clavure-data/allow-analytics-to-data-tier, clavure-data/default-deny-all, clavure-data/finance-db-ingress]; permitted by clavure-data/allow-analytics-to-data-tier ingress[0] peers[0] on TCP/5432.
findings.scope_note: Network reachability (L3/L4) only: this shows that a TCP connection is permitted by the NetworkPolicy model, not that the application authorizes the request or that the resource is exploitable.
